Name: Zenith - The Ultimate Sword
Author: szzrain
Description:
[center][b][size=5]English[/size][/b][/center]
[spoiler][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod brings the legendary, reality-shattering endgame sword from [i]Terraria[/i] into [i]Stardew Valley. [/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Just like its original counterpart in[i] Terraria, Zenith [/i]fires a continuous barrage of sword projectiles tracking your cursor as long as you hold the Left Click (or X button if you are playing with a controller). These flying blades pass through any solid obstacles and walls to shred your foes. [/color]
Zenith is able to clear weeds and destroy crates in the mines. Use it with caution when you are around your farm.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
1. Make sure you have installed Content Patcher and Sprites in Detail. You can get these mods in the "Requirements" section above.
2. You need to extract all three folders from the zip file to the Mods folder.

[size=4][b]Craft Zenith[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]To forge this ultimate weapon, you must gather all 12 of the following weapons in your inventory: [/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Rusty Sword[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Insect Head[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Holy Blade[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Lava Katana[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tempered Broadsword[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Neptune's Glaive[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Abby's Planchette[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dwarf Hammer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Sam's Old Guitar[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Meowmere[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Yeti Tooth[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Infinity Blade[/color][/*]
[/list]Once all 12 materials are in your backpack, travel to the Volcano Forge on the Island (or if you have Mini-Forge). Open the forge menu, LEAVE BOTH SLOTS COMPLETELY EMPTY, and click the Forge Hammer button directly. After a spectacular custom cutscene, Zenith will be yours.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.8+[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Sprites In Detail
Secret Note Framework (Optional)[/color][/spoiler]
[center][b][size=5]中文[/size][/b][/center]
[spoiler][b][size=4]描述[/size][/b]
这个mod将泰拉瑞亚的天顶剑加入了星露谷
这把剑与它在泰拉瑞亚中的版本一样，将会在你长按鼠标左键（如果你使用的是手柄则是X键）时发射弹幕不停地打击你鼠标所指的位置。并且可以穿透任何障碍物。
同时这把剑还能够清除杂草，摧毁地牢中的木箱子，所以在农场中时需要谨慎使用。

[size=4][b]安装[/b][/size]
1. 确保你已经安装了 Content Patcher 和 Sprites in Detail 这两个模组可以在上面的"Requirement"里面下载
2. 你需要解压压缩包中的全部三个文件夹都放在Mods文件夹中

[size=4][b]制作天顶剑[/b][/size]
为了制作天顶剑，你需要准备以下武器各一份，共12件武器：
[list=1]
[*]生锈的剑[/*]
[*]昆虫头部[/*]
[*]圣剑[/*]
[*]熔岩骑士剑[/*]
[*]淬火阔剑[/*]
[*]海王星大剑[/*]
[*]阿比盖尔的占卜写板[/*]
[*]矮人锤[/*]
[*]山姆的旧吉他[/*]
[*]彩虹猫之刃[/*]
[*]雪怪之牙[/*]
[*]无限之刃[/*]
[/list]将以上所有材料放入你的背包后，来到姜岛的火山锻炉处。打开锻炉（或者你有迷你锻造台也可以），不要放任何东西进去，直接点击铸造按钮。一段动画过后，你将得到你的天顶剑。

[size=4]需求[/size]
SMAPI 4.0.8+
Content Patcher
Sprites In Detail
Secret Note Framework (可选)[/spoiler]
[center][b][size=5]Changelog[/size][/b]
[left][spoiler][b]v1.3: Supports Android.
v1.2: Optimized trailing effect. Added tracking functionality.[/b][/spoiler]
[/left]
[/center]
[center][b][size=5]更新日志[/size][/b]
[left][spoiler][b][size=3]v1.3: 支持安卓手机版
v1.2: 优化了弹幕轨迹，增加了一定程度的追踪功能[/size][/b][/spoiler]
[/left]
[/center]
